mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine complex (Nkran, Abore, Esaase pits), Asankrangwa Gold Belt; 90% owned via JV. FY2025 (100% basis): 4.9 Mt ore milled @ 0.9 g/t Au (~91% recovery); gold produced 121,191 oz (attributable 90% = 109,072 oz), sold 127,134 oz (100% basis); AISC $2,233/oz (within revised guidance); Q4 AISC $2,033/oz. Income from mine operations $66.0M; adjusted EBITDA $182.2M. 2026 guidance: 140,000-160,000 oz at AISC $2,000-$2,300/oz ($4,500/oz gold). Nkran cutback and Esaase drilling to grow reserves. Ghana royalty framework amendments proposed (would add ~$375/oz to AISC if ratified). Per-oz cash cost not disclosed for FY2025 (field null).

notes: FY2025 Q4/news release + financial statements used (year ended December 31, 2025; MD&A not in 40-F — ops data from Q4/FY2025 news release). Production = attributable ounces (release tables are AGM 100%-basis: 121,191 oz produced). FY2025: gross revenue $447.8M, net revenue $328.4M (after $119.3M realized/unrealized gold hedge losses); operating cash flow $158.0M; net loss attributable $29.3M. P&P reserves per updated estimate published February 12, 2026 (disclosed in 2025 AIF): 47.5 Mt @ 1.29 g/t = 1.97 Moz (100% AGM basis).
